basic_details.job_title: GGU Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Biotechnology, Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya (GGU), Bilaspur (C.G.), is hiring a Project Technical Support–III for an ICMR, New Delhi-funded project on CD19 CAR-NK cells for leukaemia, initially for one year, at ₹ 28000 + HRA (10%) per month. Candidates need a three-year Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related biological science with two years' post-qualification experience, or a Postgraduate degree in these subjects. They send their updated CV to [email protected] on or before 25 November 2026 and attend the walk-in interview on 26 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: GGU Project Technical Support–III at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

rows.details: Development of EZH1-Knockout iPSC-Derived CD19 CAR-NK Cells as an Off-the Shelf Immunotherapy for Relapsed/Refractory Acute and Chronic Lymphoblastic Leukemia (Project ID: IIRPIG(NAG)-I-2026-01-0896)
Initially one year, extendable up to the duration of the project (project duration: maximum 3 years)
Below 30 years on date of interview
Department of Biotechnology, Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh

content_sections.heading: About GGU
content_sections.text: Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya, Bilaspur (C.G.), is a Central University established by the Central Universities Act, 2009, and describes itself as NAAC Accredited with A++ Grade. This post is in the university's Department of Biotechnology. It serves a research project funded by ICMR, New Delhi, led by Dr Santosh Kumar, Associate Professor and Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice accepts either of the following: Three-year Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, or any other relevant biological science from a recognised university/institution, with a minimum of two years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field. OR Postgraduate degree in Life Sciences/ Biotechnology/ Biochemistry/ Microbiology or other relevant biological sciences from a recognized university/institution. The two years of post-qualification experience is required only with the three-year Bachelor's degree. The notice does not ask for experience with the Postgraduate degree. Hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture, molecular biology, cell-based assays and routine laboratory techniques. The age limit is below 30 years on the date of interview. Relaxation in age is permissible for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per Government of India rules. The notice does not print the number of years of relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Emoluments: ₹ 28000 + HRA (10%) per month for a period of two years. A 5% increment in the third year as per ICMR norms. Term of engagement: initially for a period of one year, further extendable up to the duration of the project and/or co-terminus with the research project, based on satisfactory work and conduct. Project duration: maximum 3 years. The post is purely temporary, for a limited period or for the duration of the research project funded by the funding agency.

content_sections.heading: GGU Project Technical Support–III Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate's roles and responsibilities, as printed in the notice: Assist in routine laboratory activities. Maintenance of cell cultures. Experimental work, sample management and research data compilation. Maintaining laboratory records and assisting in data analysis. Preparing project-related documents, progress reports and manuscripts. Other administrative and coordination activities as assigned by the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GGU Project Technical Support–III
content_sections.text: Prepare your updated CV. Email it to [email protected] on or before 25 November 2026. Write "Application for the post of Project Technical Support–III" in the subject line of the email. Attend the walk-in interview on 26 November 2026 with the documents listed below. The notice says applications are invited "in prescribed format", but it does not include an application format. Updated CV Original educational certificates Experience certificates Other relevant documents for verification

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview for the post of Project Technical Support–III. The interview will be held on 26 November 2026, and the mode is offline (walk-in interview). Eligible candidates may appear on that date with their documents. The notice does not specify the venue or the reporting time. Requests for online interviews may be considered in exceptional cases, based on the justification provided by the candidate. Applicants must show original documents at the time of the interaction cum interview and/or joining.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GGU Project Technical Support–III post?
faq.answer: The updated CV must be emailed to [email protected] on or before 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for GGU Project Technical Support–III?
faq.answer: Candidates need a three-year Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Microbiology or another relevant biological science with at least two years of post-qualification experience. A Postgraduate degree in these subjects from a recognized university/institution is the alternative.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 30 years on the date of interview. Relaxation is permissible for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of GGU Project Technical Support–III?
faq.answer: The pay is ₹ 28000 + HRA (10%) per month for two years, with a 5% increment in the third year as per ICMR norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives the emoluments as ₹ 28000 plus HRA at 10% per month.

faq.question: Q6. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Write "Application for the post of Project Technical Support–III" in the subject line of the email sent to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026, in offline mode. Candidates should bring their updated CV, original educational certificates, experience certificates and other relevant documents.

faq.question: Q8. Can the interview be attended online?
faq.answer: Requests for online interviews may be considered in exceptional cases, based on the justification provided by the candidate.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary and tied to the research project. It is initially for one year, extendable up to the project duration of a maximum of 3 years.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no T.A./D.A. or any other allowance will be paid for attending the interaction cum interview.
